dispositions.reason: The trigger now prioritizes and raises exact activity- or shelf-limit codes that map directly to the two documented 409 responses.
The duplicate snippet state was removed; operation state now gates list and read behavior, and delete-pending UI behavior is explicit.
The evidence plan now requires a second fresh browser context showing the kept snippet and the continued absence of the deleted snippet.
Lifecycle changes now use guarded single statements or a transactional D1 batch, with affected-row checks and explicit lost-precondition handling.
Known API method mismatches return 405, unknown API paths return JSON 404, and non-GET/HEAD non-API requests never reach assets.
Deleting an unknown ID or failed save now returns 404, so only a pre-existing operation can produce deletion success and its durable fence.

supervisorFinding: DELETE retry is disabled for persisted deletePending rows; a removed index row can also make an unfinished cleanup ID undiscoverable after refresh.
